Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for AIIMS Jodhpur Project Nurse III Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for the AIIMS Jodhpur recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for the AIIMS Jodhpur recruitment is Project Nurse III. This is a contractual position released through a walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Project Nurse III post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Project Nurse III post at AIIMS Jodhpur. Candidates are encouraged to check the official notification for any further details.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for AIIMS Jodhpur?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Project Nurse III post at AIIMS Jodhpur is scheduled for 25 August 2026. Candidates should ensure they report on time.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Nurse III position?
faq.answer: The required educational qualification is B.Sc Nursing or GNM with Post Basic B.Sc Nursing. Desirable experience in research and computer knowledge are also preferred.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for the Project Nurse III post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project Nurse III position is 35 years. No specific minimum age is mentioned in the provided data.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Project Nurse III role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Project Nurse III post will receive a salary of Rs. 28,000/- per month, plus House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive at AIIMS Jodhpur.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Project Nurse III recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Nurse III recruitment at AIIMS Jodhpur will be based on a Walk-in Interview. Candidates need to attend the interview with all required documents.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the AIIMS Jodhpur located?
faq.answer: AIIMS Jodhpur is located in Jodhpur, Rajasthan, with the pincode 342005. The walk-in interview will be conducted at the AIIMS Jodhpur office.
